subject.title: [Bug] Cron Job 使用错误的飞书账号发送消息 - 缺少 accountId 自动推断

question: When a cron job omits `delivery.accountId`, should cron delivery prefer the agent/channel binding over session-derived `lastAccountId`, or preserve the current session-account precedence?
rationale: Both choices affect security and compatibility: binding-first prevents stale session account drift, while session-first may preserve workflows that intentionally inherit the most recent account context.

options.title: Prefer binding after explicit account
options.body: Keep explicit `delivery.accountId` first, then use the agent/channel binding before any session-derived account, and fail closed when the binding is ambiguous.

options.title: Preserve session precedence
options.body: Keep current behavior and document that multi-account cron jobs must set `delivery.accountId` explicitly when session account inheritance is not desired.

options.title: Add an explicit policy surface
options.body: Require a new opt-in cron delivery account policy or migration before changing existing account precedence.

recommendation.title: Prefer binding after explicit account
recommendation.body: Keep explicit `delivery.accountId` first, then use the agent/channel binding before any session-derived account, and fail closed when the binding is ambiguous.
